args.goal: Test one Canadian public procurement source for a current buyer-authored paid standalone data cleanup, catalogue reconciliation or CSV quality-assurance deliverable. Read relevant lessons and prior Canadian procurement results first and reuse any equivalent committed decision. Use the official CanadaBuys tender search and at most two original buyer notices. Confirm that a separate bid is permitted, the response deadline is open, the supplier and submission prerequisites are actionable, and at least one published acceptance criterion can be demonstrated offline. For the first fit, run the existing checker on one fictional sample tailored to that criterion and save the exact command, actual output, source quotation and hash, and a copy-ready submission handoff. If the official source is inaccessible or no notice qualifies, save the precise coverage gap or decisive exclusion and the specific buyer evidence that would reopen this route. Keep advertised value, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. Use no external contact, registration, submission, spending or deployment. Read back the committed result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson.
